title: What qualifications do Speech Therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network hold?
metaTitle: Professional Speech Therapists | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Get to know the professional, well-qualified team of Speech Therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network specializing in pediatric communication disorders.
html: Child-focused and enthusiastic, our Speech Therapists are qualified professionals bearing degrees in Speech-Language Pathology. They have a broad range of experience in addressing pediatric communication difficulties, particularly those associated with Autism.
